status: Revision 2: simpler concepts for review only. No addon implementation.
design_notes: Single flat signal color, open silhouette, no material rendering. Preview at game-sized dimensions. Pointer is intended above the nameplate; other two centered on the target.

concepts.name: 1 — Split Ring
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: minimal in-game targeting marker for Highground. This is a tiny functional combat UI glyph, designed to be instantly readable at 32 to 52 pixels over a moving game character.
Make ONE flat 2D icon on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Use a single solid pale gold color #FFD66B with a crisp thin near-black #091018 contour around the strokes. Smooth clean antialiased edges. Uniform narrow strokes: colored stroke roughly 3 percent of canvas width; black outline roughly 1.5 percent of canvas width. Center the icon with balanced transparent padding. Most of the image must remain transparent.
Extremely simple geometry, with no illustration or material rendering. NO metal, bevels, reflections, shading, gradients, gems, crown, shield, spikes, decorative flourishes, background, border tile, glow, shadow, text, extra dots, particles or additional symbols. The shape is the entire design. No secondary accent color. Practical restrained HUD graphic, not a fantasy badge. Do not add details.
Geometry: a perfectly circular outline, broken by a small clear gap at 12 o'clock and another matching gap at 6 o'clock. Exactly TWO smooth arcs, a left semicircular arc and a right semicircular arc. The circle's diameter is 70 percent of the canvas width. Plain squared-off arc ends. Hollow transparent center, no central dot, no crosshair ticks, no extra pieces. Thin even stroke throughout. It should look like a clean open circular target locator.

Geometry: exactly TWO small opposing chevrons: > on the left and < on the right, pointing inward toward a completely empty center. Each chevron consists of just two 45-degree diagonal strokes. Plain ends. No top or bottom elements, no ring, no center dot. Minimal >    < targeting brackets that leave the character visible.

refinement_prompt:
Edit the supplied minimal game targeting glyph. Change ONLY stroke weight and outline thickness. Preserve its exact basic geometry, number of pieces, placement, flat pale-gold #FFD66B color and transparent background.
The current hairline black contour is too thin for combat. Make the full shape a substantial BLACK SILHOUETTE with a narrower gold line centered inside it. At a 52 by 52 pixel display size the gold core must be roughly TWO PIXELS thick, with a clearly visible ONE-PIXEL solid near-black border on EACH SIDE of every gold stroke, for a total visible stroke width of approximately FOUR PIXELS. At this large source resolution, gold core width approximately 4 percent of total canvas width and black outline width approximately 2 percent of canvas width on each side. The dark border must be clearly, visibly substantial, never a thin hairline. Both inner and outer sides of the gold stroke need the same bold dark contour.
Flat even colors, crisp smooth geometry. No metal, gradients, bevels, reflections, shadows, glow, added dots, symbols or decoration. Keep all empty spaces genuinely transparent. Keep one glyph only, no labels or text. This is a pragmatic high-contrast UI icon, not an illustration.
